cause: Native recovery test exposed a failure-status/process-exit race. Scheduler could start pending work after a worker published failure but before process.poll reported its exit.
scored_settings: Headless mode; no automatic startup recovery. Completed v2 trials had no infrastructure failure.
fix: Pause new launches while any active worker has published an infrastructure failure; apply recovery after process exit.
test: Fake failing worker holds process open150ms after publishing failure; full40test suite.
